runtime.connectingBody: The Tenshu tab hosting Timeline is busy. Timeline will load as soon as it answers.
runtime.elsewhereTitle: Tenshu is open in another tab
runtime.elsewhereBody: Tenshu runs in one tab at a time, so your data can't get out of step. Use it here to move it to this tab.
runtime.moving: Waiting for the other tab to finish saving. This can take up to two minutes.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This part of Timeline hit an unexpected error. Your data is safe — nothing was changed.

stream.stopped: Updates stopped — what you see may be out of date.

home.emptyBody: Your timeline is recorded on your phone and appears here once it has synced.

moment.placePending: A place not on this device yet
moment.subjectPending: The details of this moment haven’t reached this device yet. They appear once they sync.

trip.noDays: None of this trip’s moments are on this device yet.
trip.missing: {count, plural, one {# moment of this trip hasn’t reached this device yet.} other {# moments of this trip haven’t reached this device yet.}}

places.empty: Places appear as your timeline fills in.

place.redirected: The place you opened was merged into this one.
place.folded: {count, plural, one {# place merged into this one} other {# places merged into this one}}
place.noVisits: No visits on this device yet.

roleDialog.title: Label this place
roleDialog.body: Your answer is saved as yours and syncs to your devices. Tenshu never overwrites it.

merge.title: Same place?
merge.body: Pick the place this one is really part of.
merge.noOthers: There is no other place to merge with.
merge.confirmBody: “{a}” and “{b}” become one place with all their visits. You can separate them again later from the place’s page.

unmerge.title: Separate this place?
unmerge.body: “{name}” becomes its own place again, with its own visits.

map.noWebGL: This browser can’t draw maps (WebGL is off or unsupported).
map.noRegion: No map data for this area.

errors.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_invalid_caller: This app is not allowed to do that.
errors.error_unannounced_session: Tenshu needs to reconnect. Please try again.
errors.error_unsupported_operation: This version does not support that yet.
errors.error_timeline_invalid_zone: Your browser’s time zone isn’t recognised, so days can’t be grouped.
errors.error_timeline_place_not_found: That place is no longer available.
errors.error_timeline_not_merged: That place isn’t merged into another, so there is nothing to separate.
errors.error_timeline_suggestion_gone: This suggestion changed in the meantime. Here is the current one.
errors.error_timeline_already_merged: These are already the same place.
errors.error_timeline_source_silent: Part of your timeline hasn’t answered yet. It may still arrive — try again in a moment.
errors.bridge: Couldn’t reach Tenshu. Make sure it is open and unlocked, then try again.
errors.bridge_timeout: Tenshu took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.bridge_not_permitted: Timeline is not allowed to do that.
errors.error_map_transport_unconfigured: Maps aren’t available on the web yet.
errors.error_map_transport_failed: Map tiles couldn’t be loaded. Try again.
errors.error_map_catalog_unverified: The map catalogue couldn’t be verified, so no map is shown.
errors.error_map_unknown_region: This map area is no longer available.
errors.error_map_unavailable: Maps are unavailable right now. Try again later.
